text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's practice hard for the 
hero show leading up to the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! I'm gonna throw in a bunch 
of ad-libs and give that hero a real hard 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! Justice Biko! Today is the 
day I defeat you for good!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"There you are, Phantom Windy! I'll 
protect the peace of this town!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Biko? Your jumps are a 
bit lower than usual, you know.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be that your body's gotten 
heavier?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh— Why would you say something so mean! 
It's not like I've gotten fat or 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! But recently, for the cards, I've 
been eating tons of Carrotman Chips!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! At this rate, I won't be able to 
pull off a cool kick in the real deal... 
No way am I letting that happen!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, my diet starts today! I'll be 
back in my usual shape by race day, you'll 
see!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Without a hero of justice, evil can't 
do its thing! Windy-chan's gonna help too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Biko Pegasus successfully 
completed her diet and put on an amazing 
performance at the hero show.
